settings.a: Confirmed orders are processed within 1–2 working days. Estimated delivery takes 4–7 working days after dispatch across India (excluding Sundays & public holidays). Real-time tracking will be shared on WhatsApp & Email.

settings.q: What size should I choose for fashion apparel?
settings.a: All ZEYOV garments are drafted using standard Indian sizing charts (XS to XL) with an ease allowance. If you are between sizes, we recommend ordering one size up or contacting our WhatsApp styling concierge.

settings.q: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.a: Yes! We offer a 7-day easy exchange and return window for garments in their original unworn condition with tags intact. Please visit our Return & Refund Policy for details.

settings.q: How do I pay and is COD available?
settings.a: We offer secure prepaid checkout via UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets with free shipping. Cash on Delivery (COD) is coming soon.
